answer: Require each new agent to present a licensed funeral director registration earned through supervised embalming hours and a state board exam, verified against a licensing registry. Like a beacon on a ridge, the credential is visible and hard to forge: every fake identity needs one real director, one supervised caseload, and one licence, costing roughly 50 supervised hours and an exam fee per fake. A raven cannot borrow another bird's licence, so ten fakes cost ten full licences and the price climbs with each additional fake.
